prompt_html: True or false: To change the number of put options displayed in the Option Chain window, access the Strike Price menu above the Put display area and select the desired number of strikes.
True or false: Using the mouse to hover above any ask price in the Option Chain will cause a blue backdrop to appear. When hovering above a bid price, the background turns red.
True or false: When buying or selling option contracts the user can only enter a market order.
